observed_discontinuity: Frozen Bubble GameThread.<init> calls BitmapFactory.decodeResource(Resources, int, Options). AGR skipped the unresolved method, so the source Bitmap stayed null and scaleFrom threw NullPointerException.
required_semantics: decodeResource(Resources, int, Options) returns a Bitmap whose width and height are the encoded image size.
A missing or undecodable resource returns null.
Options.inBitmap set and a failed decode throws IllegalArgumentException.
Options.inJustDecodeBounds returns null and writes outWidth and outHeight.
Bitmap.getWidth and Bitmap.getHeight return those dimensions.

differences.description: API19 BitmapFactory.decodeResource opens the raw resource and returns a Bitmap. AGR previously had no LLIL method, so the invoke was skipped and the result was null.
differences.relevance: GameThread stored null source bitmaps, and scaleFrom threw NullPointerException.

earliest_evidenced_divergence: API19 decodeResource(Resources, int, Options) returns the decoded Bitmap; AGR skipped Landroid/graphics/BitmapFactory;.decodeResource LLIL.

evidence.artifact: Pinned android-4.4.4_r2 BitmapFactory.decodeResource and Bitmap.getWidth/getHeight in framework.graphics.bitmap_decode_resource

Local host probe of unchanged org.jfedor.frozenbubble 1.7 after the LLIL method: 40 BitmapFactory.decodeResource calls return OK. PNG, JPEG, and GIF resource ids resolve through resources.arsc to res/drawable entries. Two choreographer frames still report created_count 1, changed_count 1, and a content Surface distinct from the root. scaleFrom still throws Ljava/lang/NullPointerException. GameView's invoke of setRunning enters GameThread.cleanUp, which writes a non-object into mBackground at pc 330 after the constructor stored the BmpWrap. Thread.start does not run. This is not a first frame.

remaining_uncertainty: Density scaling is not applied. Frozen Bubble sets Options.inScaled false through unresolved reflection, and the returned size is the encoded image size.
createScaledBitmap and lockCanvas were not reached.
The setRunning to cleanUp dispatch is a pre-existing invoke target and is not changed here.
next_action: Do not start another Simulator for the answered surfaceCreated question. The next public stop is GameThread.cleanUp clearing mBackground before scaleFrom. Do not implement lockCanvas.
host_adaptation: The Bitmap stores the resource path and the encoded width and height. It does not allocate a pixel buffer and it is not the ViewRoot Surface. Nine-patch PNG content size subtracts the one-pixel border when an npTc chunk is present.
